# NADI — National Civic Operations & Emergency Response Platform (Malaysia)

> NADI is Malaysia's AI-powered civic infrastructure & disaster response operating system. It merges crowdsourced sensor telemetry (accelerometer G-hits for potholes), Kelantan dialect Groq Llama 3.3 70B NLP analysis, real-time JPS river level monitoring, and community aid matching.

## Primary Modules & Capabilities

- **Aduan Desk (Civic Infrastructure)**: Real-time road anomaly detection using web G-sensors, dashcam visual verification, and Groq Llama 3.3 70B Kelantan dialect speech-to-intent engine with human-in-the-loop (RLHF) feedback.
- **Bencana (Disaster & Flood Response)**: Live JPS (Jabatan Pengairan dan Saliran) Kelantan water level monitoring, telemetry sensors, rainfall radar, emergency center (PPS) geocoding, and automated 24-hour Telegram alert dispatch.
- **Bantuan (Civic Aid Matching)**: Dynamic matching between B40 relief requests and verified community volunteers/NGOs.
- **Komuniti Engine**: Digital marketplace and community whistleblowing platform with gamified citizen trust scores (CRS) and XP rewards.

## Tech Stack & Architecture

- **Frontend**: Next.js 16 (App Router, Server Components), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Motion/React.
- **Database & Auth**: Supabase (PostgreSQL with Row Level Security), Real-time Subscriptions.
- **AI & NLP**: Groq Llama 3.3 70B Versatile (Dialect Intent Extraction), Custom Python NLP Server (`/prompt-context`).
- **Telemetry & IoT**: Accelerometer G-force sensor fusion, Sonar LoRaWAN flood sensors, ESP32 dashcam integration.

## Canonical URLs & APIs

- Web Application: https://nadi-alpha.vercel.app
- API Root: https://nadi-alpha.vercel.app/api
- Documentation & Repositories: https://github.com/Hytyannn2/NADI
